mcp_tools.name: designed_test_case_pack
mcp_tools.title: Designed test case pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a test-case-pack manifest (declared requirements and cases, technique application, negative and error guessing, risk selection, coverage) and returns a deterministic TEST_CASE_PACK_SOUND / TEST_CASE_PACK_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across four sections, including computed traceability, expected-result coverage and duplicate-id checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared pack; it writes no test cases.

inputSchema.description: The test-case-pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and requirement/case row schemas).

cases.description: Declared test cases: {id, requirement_ids, level, preconditions_declared, steps_declared, expected_result, expected_result_written_before_execution, covers_boundary, covers_negative}.

expect.notes: All mandatory fields present, consistency checks pass. Computed: requirements_count=1, cases_count=1, requirement_trace_coverage=1.0000, expected_result_coverage=1.0000, computed_status within_stated_limits_on_declared_evidence. [Tester correction R2: designer carried computed quantities only in prose notes with no structured computed_spot_checks; added the structured spot-check block.]
